name: Augustine, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Prague
insider_take: Stay where monks once walked—this 13th-century monastery turned luxury sanctuary sits in the shadow of Prague Castle, offering guests a truly mystical experience in the heart of Lesser Town.
whats_special: The Augustine occupies a meticulously restored Augustinian monastery from 1285, complete with original Gothic and Baroque architecture. The hotel's unique St. Thomas Brewery has been brewing beer on-site since 1352, making it one of the world's oldest operating breweries. Many rooms feature stunning views of Prague Castle, just a 2-minute walk away.
pro_tip: Book a Superior Castle View room on the upper floors for unobstructed views of Prague Castle's illuminated spires at night—it's pure magic and worth every crown.
dont_miss: The hotel's atmospheric wine cellar in the original monastery's 13th-century vaults, and a evening stroll through the enchanting Kampa Island gardens, accessible via the famous Charles Bridge just steps from your door. The nearby Wallenstein Garden offers a peaceful baroque escape with roaming peacocks.
pros: Historic 13th-century monastery setting with preserved architectural elements
Prime location in Lesser Town near Prague Castle and Charles Bridge
Michelin-starred Augustine Restaurant offering exceptional dining
Unique St. Thomas Brewery on-site with craft beer experience
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects heritage property status
Historic building constraints may limit modern amenities in some rooms
